dedupe_keys.name: code for a coupled transport economics model of demand dynamic supply and generalized cost oriented to the ex ante evaluation of alternative urban metropolitan medium capacity transit systems under uncertainty conditions tramway or light rail lrt vs bus semirapid transit bst

description: Emilio Conles, Alfonso Orro and Margarita Novales at Universidade da Coruña publish a MATLAB model comparing light rail or tramways with bus semirapid transit on a hypothetical urban corridor. The January 2024 code links demand, dynamic service attributes, generalised costs and travellers’ modal choices over an appraisal period. Monte Carlo draws represent uncertainty. Model_Code.zip includes default artificial inputs in datainput.m, with fullmodel as the documented entry point. A companion MAT workspace at Zenodo 10501304 provides computed results and intermediate variables for subsequent appraisal. Both deposits state CC BY 4.0 and free access; running the code requires MATLAB. The model can support prospective corridor simulations, but transferability and calibration to a real city remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. The code, inputs and companion workspace were not downloaded or executed.
